name: Xoáy chém lửa
desc: a pink-fire swirl slash: a thick yellow blade with a pink band on its inner side, pink licks reaching back into the yellow and a needle tail sweeps 330 degrees in four drawings and hooks into the centre, then breaks in place into four crescents of different sizes and fates (fade, split, curl tighter) that thin, turn and drift out, cooling to amber and pink, ending in sparks; two-scale pink glow
